## Focus

- Production conversational AI, RAG, and multi-agent systems
- Full-stack product engineering across web, mobile, APIs, and data
- Cloud infrastructure, containers, infrastructure as code, and operations
- Founder and software architect of n3tz and its AI receptionist product, Empfang

## Selected work

- Empfang by n3tz: real-time AI receptionist for phone and web
- Enterprise AI systems: document intelligence, retrieval, and agent orchestration
- Commerce platforms: multi-role marketplaces, payments, localization, realtime order tracking, and performance
